hypothesis: For the identical product and pricing, a premium/outcome-framed landing page with a highlighted recommended plan lifts signup conversion over a value/savings-framed compact page — and the lift is uneven across personas (premium-seeking users convert more on the premium framing; cost-sensitive users are unmoved or convert more on the value framing).

factors.label: Landing page design
factors.description: Which self-hosted landing page the persona lands on. Same product and prices in both; only copy framing and layout change. The signup CTA is identical in destination (/signup); conversion is the persona clicking through to it.
